# BrunTwinSum — the twin primes' reciprocals add up to a finite total

**Generated file — do not edit.** Regenerated by `python scripts/graph.py`.

**Status:** cited from a published paper; not proved in Lean

The reciprocals of the twin primes have a finite sum (Brun's constant, about 1.902), whether or not there are infinitely many twin primes. Its sieve heart is the wheel-level twin share of ShareBounds. Brun's theorem, cited.
